Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: first character appearance concept for a small pixel-art martial-arts fantasy RPG; one character, one standing pose.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent PNG background. No scenery, ground plane, cast shadow, text, border or watermark.
Subject: Yeonmuk, a young ADULT anthropomorphic fox talisman practitioner. Silver-white and soft gray fur, large pointed fox ears, a clearly visible fluffy fox tail, a slender agile build, a narrow mature fox muzzle, small confident eyes and a restrained self-assured smile. Gender-neutral presentation; no exaggerated gender traits. Compact RPG proportions with a large head but slightly longer limbs and a more angular adult face than a stocky tiger brawler; roughly 2.5 heads tall, clearly an adult rather than a child.
Clothing and equipment: practical loose dark NAVY traveling clothes, a TEAL cloth sash, understated dark trousers and travel shoes. A small waist talisman pouch and a calligraphy brush visibly tucked at the waist. Hold one small OCHRE paper talisman with a tiny RED seal away from the torso so the whole costume is readable. Simple abstract seal marks, not readable lettering.
Style/medium: crisp low-resolution-style pixel art. Chunky deliberate square pixel clusters, thin near-black warm outlines, a restrained palette, just 2–3 shades per material and modest sculpted volume. Aim for the coarse visual density of a character designed for a roughly 64-pixel-tall sprite, shown enlarged for concept review. Avoid smooth illustration, painted texture, excessive tiny details, glossy 3D rendering or antialiased blurry edges.
Composition/framing: one complete full-body character centered with comfortable transparent margins, almost straight front view with only a very slight turn. Both feet planted at the same ground level, relaxed ready-to-travel idle posture. Full ears, brush, talisman and tail all visible. Tail sits beside/behind the legs without covering the outfit. No attack pose, floating pose, weapons or magical effects obscuring the body.
Constraints: only this fox character; no tiger, comparison panel, additional poses, sprite sheet, background or extra characters. Preserve genuine transparency.
